decisions.reason: With the 72-hour and broader express lines withdrawn, the fifteen-day program is now the surviving express offer, so management sees it as the consolidated version of its delivery-speed commitment and treats weak results as teething problems, though its low visibility and low investment keep withdrawal risk notable.
The European-approved exterior door was publicly launched at BAU as part of the core Teckentrup 62 system, so sunk certification costs and visible commitment strongly favor keeping it.
The digital ordering and services platform embodies substantial development investment and the announced service-oriented direction, so shortfalls are attributed to adoption lag rather than failure.
The fire and smoke protection door belongs to the certified core safety portfolio, and its approval investment and centrality make withdrawal unlikely.
